## Context
Slice C1 recorded 12 below-seam ambient config reads in the reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface as `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`, below the seams enforced by the in-process AST gate `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent C3a 6633-219e-988a-42f6; grandparent C3 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab. Disjoint file subtree from sibling C3a-CORE (ba8b).

The 12 flagged reads (path :: symbol), all under `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/`:
- `access_check.py` :: JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT (probe scope + probe client)
- `adapters/jira/acli_subprocess.py` :: JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT (env fallback), load_config (`_acli_call_timeout` L86, `resolve_jira_settings` L119)
- `adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py` :: REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE via the `_rebar_env` shim
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/settings.py` :: load_config (`resolve_comment_max_chars` L83, `resolve_jira_datacenter_settings` L97)
- `adapters/jira_family/rich_text.py` :: load_config (`cutover_clients` L90)
- `adapters/jira_family/wiki_render.py` :: load_config (`_pandoc_timeout` L352)

Affected SOURCE files: the 6 above plus `src/rebar/config.py`/`_config_sources.py` (owned resolvers) and `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` (remove rows).

## Why the JIRA_* reads are flagged (gate mechanism)
The gate classifies `os.environ.get("X")` as owner=**credential** only if X is a derived credential name (`rebar._child_env._ADAPTER_SECRET_NAMES` = ONLY `JIRA_API_TOKEN`/`JIRA_PAT`; JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT are intentionally absent/non-secret), else owner=**composition**. So JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT are owner=composition reads: even as direct `os.environ.get` literals in a credential-boundary file they stay flagged. The correct cut routes them through an OWNED `config.py` resolver (composition root). The `JIRA_API_TOKEN`/`JIRA_PAT` reads are owner=credential, already owned, out of scope.

## Decision rule
- **(a) CUT-TO-SEAM (11 of 12).** A composed-config read is routed through an owned `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` resolver (reuse `compose_config()`/`load_config()`; add narrow named resolvers), so the ambient read moves into the composition root. Each adapter helper delegates to the owned resolver INTERNALLY (signature unchanged). Timing: the JIRA endpoint + reconciler knobs resolve LIVE per operation today (env over file, re-read each call); the resolvers read live per call — never composed once and threaded — so a mid-pass env override is not lost.
- **(b) OWNED-IN-PLACE via `# read-via:` marker (cap 1 read = 1 line).** `outbound_fields.py` `REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE` — subsystem debug switch (`=1` emits a side-car RECON record; off by default; not in the config schema). No other listed read is marked.

## Cut details (each helper delegates internally, signatures unchanged)
- **`access_check.py` JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT** (`_resolve_probe_scope`, `_build_probe_client`): read the non-secret trio from an injectable `env` mapping (default `os.environ`), live per probe, via owned `config.py` `resolve_jira_endpoint(env=None)->(url,user,project)`. `JIRA_API_TOKEN` stays in-boundary (owned).
- **`acli_subprocess.py`**: `resolve_jira_settings` (L119) non-secret url/user/project resolution (env-over-file + `InsecureUrlError` fail-loud / `ConfigError` degrade) moves into an owned resolver; the helper delegates and appends env-only `JIRA_API_TOKEN`. `_acli_call_timeout` (L86) → owned `resolve_acli_timeout()` (same 0/negative→default clamp).
- **`jira_datacenter/settings.py`**: `resolve_comment_max_chars` (L83) and `resolve_jira_datacenter_settings` (L97) delegate to owned resolvers preserving FAIL-LOUD (no `except ConfigError`) and `>0 else 0=unlimited`; `JIRA_PAT` stays in-boundary.
- **`jira_family/rich_text.py`** `cutover_clients` (L90) and **`wiki_render.py`** `_pandoc_timeout` (L352) delegate to owned resolvers preserving BOTH `except ConfigError`→default AND `except ImportError`→default: these helpers run in a stdlib-only pandoc subprocess where `rebar` may not be importable, so the delegation keeps the import lazy/guarded and falls back to the same default when `import rebar...` raises ImportError — the stdlib-only-subprocess importability invariant is unchanged.
- **`outbound_fields.py` `os.environ.get`**: the module-local `_rebar_env` shim serves only the single VERBOSE read; inline it to a literal `os.environ.get("REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE", "0")` (marked, treatment b) and DELETE the unused shim — one caller here; siblings have own copies.

## Affected TEST consumers (updated in-scope)
Drive the cut env/config through the new resolvers/typed config: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/{test_config_jira_wiring,test_config_file_wiring,test_acli_subprocess_timeout}.py`; `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/{test_jira_dc_config_settings,test_rich_text_cutover,test_wiki_render_hardening,test_dc_pat_required_heldout}.py`; probe `tests/scripts/bridge/test_jira_capability_probe.py`. Assertions preserved; only the injection seam changes. Call sites confirmed via Serena `find_referencing_symbols` + a string `grep` — no signature change needed.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
Held-out `tests/scripts/test_reconciler_jira_seam_clean_heldout.py` (gate scripts imported by bare name: `import check_config_ownership`) asserts: (i) `check(REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding for any of the 6 listed files; (ii) `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` has zero entries for a listed file; (iii) `# read-via:` markers across the 6 files total exactly 1, confined to `outbound_fields.py`. Behavior regressions kept green: JIRA endpoint env-over-file LIVE precedence (a mid-pass override is still observed after the cut), `resolve_jira_settings` insecure-url fail-loud + malformed-config degrade, DC fail-loud, the acli timeout clamp, and the rich_text/wiki_render `ImportError`→default degrade — via the consumers above plus `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler`.

## Portability / rollback
The gate is in-process AST with no CI-provider trigger; the cutover adds no CI dependency. No stored-format or config-key changes; env/file precedence and defaults are byte-preserved. Rollback = revert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 11 composed-config reads are cut-to-seam through owned resolvers, live-per-call for the JIRA endpoint + reconciler knobs; no ambient config read remains below the seam in the 6 files.
- [ ] Exactly 1 read (`REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE`) is owned-in-place with a `# read-via:` marker; no other listed read is marked.
- [ ] The secret `JIRA_API_TOKEN`/`JIRA_PAT` boundary reads are unchanged (owner=credential, owned).
- [ ] The 12 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows are removed; `check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out oracle incl. marker-total==1 / per-file-placement).
- [ ] The Testing regressions pass: JIRA-endpoint live-precedence, insecure-url fail-loud, DC fail-loud, acli-timeout-clamp, and rich_text/wiki_render ImportError->default degrade each verified; deltas noted as a comment.
